verdict.rationale: The official quickstart walks a developer through indexing sample data in Algolia and building a working search UI with React InstantSearch, and the CLI offers a browser-based sign-in or account creation to get started quickly. Independent developers describe Algolia as easy to set up, praise its developer experience and documentation, and contrast it favorably with installing ElasticSearch. Missing for 10: no explicit or measured 'within minutes' time-to-first-search, and the step-by-step index creation and record upload in the quickstart is only summarized, not shown.
